306:t_007:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units! All that's left is to crush them head-on with sheer force! We're going all out!」

306:t_007:8.en:
$n
(...$$宗介$$... You're not here, are you...)

306:t_007:9.en:
$n
(But I believe. I believe you're alive...!)

306:t_008:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「Let's hurry. $$アマルガム$$'s pursuit force is coming.」

306:t_008:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「But it's going to get rough if things keep on like this.」

306:t_008:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「For now, fighting with our machines patched up just to keep them going is dangerous...」

306:t_009:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Wait. This is $$ウルズ$$ 1.」

306:t_009:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Are you the one who arranged that transport ship and is piloting it?」

306:t_009:4.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「No... I didn't get this ship ready, and I'm not the one running it.」

306:t_009:7.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Apparently $$ＡＧ$$ is integrated with the ship's control systems.」

306:t_009:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's the situation. I can't match $$ブライト$$ or $$ジェフリー$$, but I'd appreciate your cooperation.」

306:t_009:10.en:
$$カレン$$
「Even arranging a ship for us - that's a dimensional merchant for you!」

306:t_009:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm delighted by your praise, but I must inform you all of the latest bad news.」

306:t_009:13.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「...$$メリダ島$$ has fallen in the $$アマルガム$$ attack.」

306:t_010:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Damn it! Th-this fight is on hold for now!!」

306:t_011:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Every single time... the same lines...」

306:t_011:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「$$ロジャー$$. Why don't you lend him a little vocabulary?」

306:t_011:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I doubt a crude petty crook like him could ever wield my words.」

306:t_011:3.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「I agree completely, for once.」

306:t_012:0.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「This is bad... $$アマルガム$$'s main force is coming.」

306:t_012:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「With this strength... we can't win...」

306:t_012:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Is this as far as we go...!」

306:t_100:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Negotiator! Coming at us with brute force - did you lose your job!?」

306:t_100:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Negotiation has no way forward with an opponent who can't understand words. In that respect, you are not much different from $$バアル$$.」

306:t_100:2.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Let you talk... Then I'll crush you with force!」

306:t_101:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Y-you and you! You ruined my tactics, and you wiped out my trump card!」

306:t_101:1.en:
$n
「Sorry about that. To make it up to you, I'll make sure you never have to fight again.」

306:t_101:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Hm... I can learn a lot from his trash talk myself.」

306:t_101:5.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Though it doesn't look the least bit usable for any proper negotiation.」

306:t_102:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$, $$シャッコ$$! The day has finally come to settle the score between us!」

306:t_102:1.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「That line... Do you remember how many times that's been?」

306:t_102:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I wasn't listening to his words in the first place.」

306:t_102:4.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Y-you bastard!! That attitude is exactly what I can't forgive!!」

306:t_103:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Survivors of $$ミスリル$$! Even if you escape here, all that awaits you is despair!」

306:t_103:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「Still all talk, aren't you, $$カン・ユー$$!」

306:t_103:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'll make that AT, way too good for you, your coffin, so hurry up and go to sleep!」

306:t_104:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$ゼロ$$, Leader of the $$黒の騎士団$$, and the $$ナイトオブゼロ$$ ganging up on me - how despicable!」

306:t_104:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「Where do you get the nerve to say that...!」

306:t_104:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Call us despicable all you like.」

306:t_104:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Don't think scum like you can shake my resolve, my will, or my fight!」

306:t_105:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「Fine, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$! I've got a grudge against him too!」

306:t_105:3.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「D-don't tell me... you're still angry about the bunny girl thing at $$クメン$$!?」

306:t_105:4.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's not what I'm talking about now! I can't forgive the gall of becoming a lackey for $$アマルガム$$ and attacking us!」

306:t_105:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「I only just remembered the bunny girl thing! While I'm at it, I'll pay you back for that too!」

306:t_105:6.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Y-you are angry after all!」

306:t_105:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You two might be about even in tenacity...」

306:t_106:0.en:
$n
(I'm sorry, $$宗介$$... I couldn't save you and $$千鳥$$...)

306:t_106:1.en:
$n
(But it's not over yet...! I'll definitely find you!)

306:t_106:2.en:
$n
(And then I'll do it...! I'll definitely rescue $$千鳥$$!)

311:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マーティアル$$ Church HQ, Pope's Office ～

311:t_1:4.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「...A report just came in from the branch in $$クメン$$.」

311:t_1:6.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「$$キリコ・キュービィー$$... That man is in $$クメン$$ right now.」

311:t_1:7.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「...By laying hands on the Untouchable, the $$マーティアル$$ Church lost its authority. And still you haven't learned your lesson...」

311:t_1:8.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Silence, $$ロッチナ$$. Do not forget that it is only by my mercy that you are kept here.」

311:t_1:10.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「$$ジャン・ポール・ロッチナ$$... Say my name.」

311:t_1:11.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「The 713th Pope of the $$マーティアル$$ Church, His Holiness $$ヴィアチェスラフ・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$.」

311:t_1:12.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Know that my words are the words of God. You may withdraw.」

311:t_1:13.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
(So this man, too, has been possessed by $$キリコ$$...)

311:t_1:14.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「...That thing is there as well... I'll dispose of it, along with $$キリコ$$.」
